title: Internet Providers in Fincastle, VA: Lumos Fiber and Xfinity
description: Internet providers in Fincastle, VA (24090): Lumos fiber up to 5 Gig from the Botetourt build, Xfinity cable, 5G home internet and satellite, per FCC data.
lead: How Fincastle and the 24090 area got fiber, who else serves it, and what to ask before you order.
short_answer: Lumos, now part of T-Mobile Fiber, reports fiber up to 5 Gbps both ways across most of Fincastle's 24090 ZIP code in June 2026 FCC data, much of it built with state and county grant funds. Xfinity cable reaches a large part at up to 1.2 Gbps. Verizon and T-Mobile 5G home internet and satellite are the other options.

sections.h2: How Fincastle got fiber: the Botetourt County and Lumos build
sections.body_html:
Botetourt County has worked with Lumos for years to bring fiber to unserved homes. A 2017 county survey found about 30% of homes had no high-speed broadband. In January 2021 the county and Lumos won a $1,364,337 Virginia Telecommunication Initiative (VATI) grant to bring fiber to 548 addresses, including 30 businesses, in areas east of the Town of Fincastle. A second VATI project, with a $3,084,796 state grant, set out to reach 1,901 more addresses, including around the towns of Buchanan and Fincastle, with a goal of universal coverage in the county by spring 2024.

The Fincastle Herald reported in December 2023 that Lumos had brought fiber to 1,239 grant-funded homes since 2021 and that the county's $2,602,514 share of the project was paid from American Rescue Plan Act funds. In the June 2026 FCC data, Lumos fiber covers most of the 24090 area, more than any other wired provider.

T-Mobile and the investment firm EQT closed their joint venture to buy Lumos on April 1, 2025, and Lumos's website now says it is part of the T-Mobile Fiber family. sections.h2: T-Mobile Fiber prices reported in November 2026
sections.body_html: CableTV.com reports no annual contract and an extra $10 a month off with an eligible T-Mobile phone plan. These are national T-Mobile Fiber prices; former Lumos areas may still show different plan names, so check the price at your Fincastle address.

Xfinity reports cable service up to 1.2 Gbps download and 35 Mbps upload across a large part of 24090. The upload speed is much lower than on fiber, which matters for video calls and backups. If you already have Xfinity, see our Xfinity bill explainer and why Xfinity bills go up.

sections.h2: Every provider reporting service in Fincastle (24090)

sections.body_html: Source: FCC Broadband Data Collection, June 30, 2026, matched to ZIP codes by YourBillCheck. Footprint compares each provider's reported locations with the widest land-based (wired or fixed wireless) provider near that ZIP code, so it is a guide, not a promise for your street.

sections.h2: If fiber has not reached your road
sections.body_html: Verizon 5G home internet reports up to 300 Mbps across most of 24090. T-Mobile also reaches most of the area, but its reported top speed here is only 25 Mbps. Wireless signal can vary from house to house, so ask about a trial. Starlink, the fastest satellite option in the FCC data at up to 280 Mbps, works anywhere with a clear view of the sky. Run a speed test on what you have now before you switch.

sections.h2: What to ask before you order
sections.body_html:
• Is my address already lit for Lumos / T-Mobile Fiber, or only planned?
  • Is there an installation or construction charge for a long driveway?
  • What is the price after any promotion, and is autopay required?
  • For Xfinity: what is the upload speed on the plan you are quoting?

faq: Is there fiber internet in Fincastle, VA?

Yes. Lumos, now part of T-Mobile Fiber, reports fiber up to 5 Gbps both ways across most of the 24090 ZIP code in the June 2026 FCC data. Much of it was built with Botetourt County and state VATI grants.
Xfinity reports cable up to 1.2 Gbps download and 35 Mbps upload across a large part of 24090. Check your address, since it does not reach every road.
How much is fiber internet in Fincastle?
CableTV.com reported T-Mobile Fiber prices in November 2026 from $35 a month for 300 Mbps to $90 for 5 Gig with autopay, plus taxes and fees. Confirm the price at your address.
What are the options for rural homes near Fincastle without fiber?
Verizon 5G home internet reaches most of 24090 at up to 300 Mbps in FCC data. Starlink, Viasat and HughesNet satellite cover the whole area with a clear sky view.
